findings.title: The first-contact derivative implication is already proved without a stationarity premise
findings.proof: CCM.firstVariation_nonpos_of_leftPrefix (FirstCrossingProductionFirstVariation.lean:370) is generic scalar calculus: f(L*)=0, f>=0 on [Lsmall,L*], Lsmall<L*, and HasDerivAt f J L* imply J<=0. It can be applied to the complete actual native K3 scalar once its own differentiability and prefix are supplied; it does not require identifying a native compressed kernel with the larger boundary-flat kernel. The named GeneratedGlobalFirstCrossing.firstVariation_nonpos_of_kernel (:411) uses the historical boundary-flat carrier. The actual fixed-vector derivative is proved in canonicalParity_fixedEnergy_hasDerivAt (:433), and GeneratedStrictEvenContact.firstVariation_nonpos_production (FirstCrossingGeneratedStrictEvenFrontier.lean:409) removes a separately supplied derivative-realization witness. production_frontier (:450) explicitly retains either strictly negative first variation or the stationary response equation. Thus the strictly negative first-order branch is a proved part of the current frontier, not a missing implementation.
findings.limits: For the moving native vector u(L), one must use the derivative of its complete scalar curve, including moving-frame terms. A positive Arch-gap value and a positive complete higher-power value do not imply a sign for that derivative. findings.title: One older quantitative lemma applies directly to the exact K3 source without contact or ground hypotheses
findings.proof: CCM.re_quadraticForm_index_le_of_mem_evenBoundaryFlat (CanonicalRecentPrimeSecondVariation.lean:65) assumes only z in evenBoundaryFlatSubspace K, omega>=0, and (2*pi*omega)^2 B(Dz)<=5|M4(z)|, where B(u)=sum |n|^5|u_n| (CanonicalSourceOddEndpointQuantitative.lean:145). It concludes e_Dz(omega)<=-(pi^6/90)|M4(z)|^2 omega^7. For the literal native K3 vectors, beta=L^2/(16*pi^2), M4(ue)=720, D ue=3uo, and B(D ue)=2[15(beta+1)+384(beta+4)+729(beta+9)]=2256beta+16224. Therefore Eo(L,omega)<=-640*pi^6*omega^7 whenever (2*pi*omega)^2(2256beta+16224)<=3600. This retains the full seven-slot Euclidean coefficients and does not unit-normalize them.
findings.exact_physical_window: With d=L*omega, the sufficient condition is (564+64896*pi^2/L^2)d^2<=3600. For any fixed 0<D<sqrt(300/47), it holds throughout 0<=d<=D once L>=max(D, sqrt(64896*pi^2*D^2/(3600-564*D^2))). The strict inequality on D is necessary for this finite threshold; the limiting endpoint itself is not paid for finite L.

findings.title: The same-source recent-prime budget is positive, but the complete PNT continuum cancels its scale
findings.proof: The actual canonical scalar is Q_o=-Arch_o-sum_(2<=q<=floor(exp L)) Lambda(q)/sqrt(q) E_o(L,1-log(q)/L). For the literal recent set 0<=d_q=L-log(q)<=D, C2 therefore proves -sum_recent Lambda(q)/sqrt(q) E_o(L,d_q/L) >= 640*pi^6/L^7 sum_recent Lambda(q)/sqrt(q) d_q^7 >=0. No prime power or floor endpoint is dropped; at d=0 the atom vanishes. Reusing the already-paid PNT measure scaling from ACTUAL_K3_UNSIGNED_PRIME_CHARGE_AUDIT P3, the right-hand side is asymptotic to 640*pi^6 exp(L/2)L^-7 integral_0^D exp(-d/2)d^7 dd. This is an explicit positive recent-sector lower budget, rather than an estimate for the complete signed scalar.

The negative source atoms in this recent window supply the positive canonical contribution; adverse source atoms elsewhere have the matching complete leading charge. The new bound is consistent with that full cancellation and cannot dominate the adverse sector. The positive polynomial Arch/higher-power budgets do not remove this ordinary-prime signed comparison.

findings.title: Other named contact budgets require their precise different test and carrier
findings.proof: GeneratedStrictEvenContact requires a unit kernel vector of the larger euclideanEvenBoundaryFlatSubspace and a strictly positive bottom on the corresponding larger odd boundary-flat carrier. Inherited stationarity uses hinh:g.shell.n<g.shell.k and an inherited kernel direction (FirstCrossingInheritedStationarity.lean:123,344). Native K3 has one-dimensional parity carriers and no nonzero native predecessor; a zero native energy is not automatically a kernel vector for the larger historical compression. CanonicalContactOlderPrimeBudget.olderPrimeBudget (:175) and olderPrimeBudget_finite (:253) additionally require zero first variation and their explicit angle inequality. Their pole/Arch test is t^2 e_Dz(1-t/L), with prime weight Lambda(q)(log q)^2/sqrt(q), not the corrected K3 gap test E_o-aE_e. The new positive Arch-gap theorem cannot be substituted for that different pole/Arch functional.

findings.title: The current joint-ground supplier does not add a hidden same-K3 inequality
findings.proof: OPICARound4.joint_ground_constraints_of_both_negative (JointGroundConstraints.lean:157) assumes both native parities negative at the same L,K. Its off-line-zero consumer (:183) supplies cofinal L with an existential K>=3, not fixed K=3. The separate fixed-K3 aperture sign-excursion deduction supplies each parity individually cofinally; it cannot be turned into this same-aperture premise. At K3 the exact raw relation is G=Q_o-(N_o/N_e)Q_e=80 Re f(ue), with scalar gap delta=G/N_o and D ue=3uo. The corresponding moment-gap inequality is saturated by the one-dimensional carrier, not an additional sign on G. In the strict-odd package the f=-1 statement concerns the distinct reciprocal even input, not the cubic-normalized odd state.
